before_snippet:
import polars as pl
import tempfile
import os

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    path = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'test.parquet')
    df = pl.DataFrame({'a': [1, 2], 'b': [3, 4]})
    df.write_parquet(path)
    try:
        pl.read_parquet(path)
    except pl.exceptions.DuplicateError:
        raise AssertionError('Should not raise DuplicateError on valid file')
title: DuplicateError raised on parquet files with duplicate column names
